reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises. E1 discusses HfMoTaTiZr's properties but does not involve Al substitution. E2 and E3 show Al-containing lightweight alloys but in different base systems (Al-Nb-Ti-V and Ti-Al-Cr-Nb-V-Zr), not HfMoTaTiZr, and do not address high-temperature strength retention after replacing Hf with Al. The premises about phase stability and property retention in the specific HfMoTaTiZr system with Al are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al substitution reduces density in refractory high-entropy alloys
Partial Hf replacement with Al retains a single-phase solid solution or beneficial precipitates
Solid-solution strengthening and lattice distortion from retained refractory elements maintain high strength
High yield strength and ductility can be preserved at room temperature and ~1000 °C after Al substitution
